title: Healthy session
description: 144 fps, GPU-bound, comfortable thermals. Nothing to report.

title: Background CPU contention
description: A background process saturates a core for 1.4 s, starving the render thread.

title: CPU frequency collapse
description: Effective clock falls 4.6 to 1.4 GHz under unchanged load. No CPU temperature sensor, so the cause cannot be attributed to heat.

title: GPU thermal throttling
description: GPU reaches 87 C, core clock falls 2610 to 1830 MHz, and the vendor reports a hardware thermal slowdown.

title: GPU power limit
description: GPU pins to a 285 W board power limit and drops core clock 2640 to 2050 MHz at 68 C, with the vendor reporting a power cap rather than a thermal one.

title: Memory pressure and paging
description: Available memory falls below 400 MB, hard faults climb to ~900/s, and frames stall waiting on the page file.

title: Unexplained hitch
description: A 96 ms hitch with every observable metric flat. The correct answer is that the cause cannot be determined, with the exclusions listed.
